description: NaV₅O₈ is Spinel-like structured and crystallizes in the cubic P4_332 space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with six equivalent VO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with nine equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-65°. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and one longer (2.02 Å) V-O bond length. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.09 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to four V atoms to form distorted corner-sharing OV₄ trigonal pyramids.
